reader_brief.intro: 이번 호는 세 가지 카메라 문제를 살펴봅니다. 검은색이 회색으로 저장되는 HeifWriter 문제, 밝기를 높이다 검은 화면이 나오는 HM1092 게인 문제, atomisp에서 불필요한 오류 검사를 제거하는 이유입니다. 각 기사에서 원인과 변경점, 확인할 대상을 차례로 설명합니다. 마지막에는 이전에 발표된 Android Studio BYOA를 짧게 소개합니다.

items.headline: AndroidX HeifWriter, 8비트 HEIF에서 검은색이 회색으로 보이는 문제 수정
items.lead: 검은색으로 저장한 부분이 회색처럼 보였다면, 픽셀 값과 파일의 색상 범위 표시가 어긋났을 수 있습니다. HeifWriter는 일부 8비트 입력에서 이 불일치를 없애는 수정을 병합했습니다.
items.takeaway: HEIF 저장 기능 담당자가 확인할 소식입니다. 특히 8비트 SDR Surface·Bitmap 입력을 살펴보세요. 직접 YUV를 넘기는 버퍼 입력과 10비트 HDR은 변경 대상이 아닙니다.

items.headline: Linux HM1092 드라이버 v7 제안: 밝기 조절로 검은 화면이 생기지 않도록 제한
items.lead: 밝기를 높이려고 넣은 값이 센서의 처리 범위를 넘으면 오히려 검은 화면이 나올 수 있습니다. HM1092 드라이버 v7은 디지털 게인 값의 상한을 정해 이 문제를 막도록 제안되었습니다.
items.takeaway: NIR 센서를 V4L2에 연결하는 개발자가 확인할 소식입니다. 게인 상한 변경과 아직 논의 중인 영상 영역 보고 방식을 나누어 살펴보세요.

items.headline: Linux atomisp 패치 제안: 작동하지 않는 오류 검사를 제거하는 이유
items.lead: atomisp에 실제로는 작동하지 않는 오류 검사가 남아 있었습니다. 이번 제안은 그 검사를 제거합니다. 반환값을 받아 검사하도록 고치면 정상적인 RAW 캡처까지 실패할 수 있기 때문입니다.
items.takeaway: atomisp 유지보수 담당자가 확인할 소식입니다. 미리보기 정보가 없다는 결과와 캡처 스트림을 만들 수 없다는 오류를 구분해야 합니다.

items.headline: 짧은 참고: Android Studio에서 쓰던 AI 에이전트를 연결하는 BYOA
items.lead: Android Studio Canary의 BYOA는 외부 AI 코딩 에이전트를 IDE 안에서 사용하게 해 주는 프리뷰 기능입니다. 9월 24일 발표된 내용을 개발 도구 참고 소식으로 소개합니다.
items.takeaway: 개발 도구를 시험하는 팀을 위한 이전 발표 참고입니다. 정식 도입 전 현재 빌드·테스트 흐름에 맞는지 확인하세요.

reader_brief.intro: This issue explains three camera topics: gray-looking blacks in HeifWriter, black frames caused by out-of-range HM1092 gain, and why atomisp should remove an unnecessary error check. Each article walks through the cause, the change, and who should check it. We close with a brief reference to the earlier Android Studio BYOA announcement.

items.headline: AndroidX HeifWriter fixes gray-looking blacks in 8-bit HEIF images
items.lead: If a saved black area looks gray, the pixel values and the file’s color range label may disagree. HeifWriter has merged a fix for this mismatch in some 8-bit input paths.
items.takeaway: This matters to developers responsible for saving HEIF images. Focus on 8-bit SDR Surface and Bitmap input. Direct YUV buffer input and 10-bit HDR are outside this change.

items.headline: Linux HM1092 driver v7 proposal limits gain to avoid black frames
items.lead: A value intended to brighten an image can instead produce a black frame if it exceeds the sensor’s range. The proposed HM1092 driver v7 limits the digital gain value to prevent this.
items.takeaway: This matters to developers connecting NIR sensors through V4L2. Review the gain limit change separately from the still-open discussion about reporting image areas.

items.headline: Linux atomisp proposal explains why a dead error check should be removed
items.lead: An error check in atomisp never actually triggered. The proposed patch removes it. Changing it to check the function’s return value could instead break valid RAW capture.
items.takeaway: This matters to atomisp maintainers. Distinguish missing preview information from an error that prevents capture stream creation.

items.headline: Brief reference: Connect your AI agent to Android Studio with BYOA
items.lead: BYOA in Android Studio Canary is a preview feature for using external AI coding agents inside the IDE. We revisit the September 24 announcement as a development tool reference.
items.takeaway: This earlier announcement is a reference for teams trying development tools. Check how it fits your build and test workflow before adopting it.

items.headline: AOSP cameraserver, 프라이버시 토글 시 조건부 mute를 유지하는 패치 제안
items.lead: 카메라 접근을 껐을 때, 화면에 표시된 앱의 연결을 유지하면서 영상만 차단하는 Android 패치가 제안됐습니다. 이 동작을 지원하는 기기에만 해당하며, 아직 적용이 확정된 변경은 아닙니다.
items.takeaway: 지원 기기에서 화면에 표시된 앱은 영상만 차단되는지 확인할 사안입니다. 기능을 지원하지 않는 기기와 나머지 앱은 기존처럼 연결이 끊기는지도 확인해야 합니다.

items.headline: Camera Extensions 조기 완료 콜백 시 발생하던 NullPointerException 및 세션 타임아웃 수정
items.lead: CameraX Extension API 사용 시 캡처 완료 콜백이 조기에 도달할 때 핸들러 스레드가 비정상 종료되던 예외가 동기화 구조 개선으로 해결되었습니다.
items.takeaway: Camera Extensions 연동 시 조기 완료 콜백 조건에서 CXCP-Camera-H 스레드의 예외 발생 여부를 점검하고 라이브러리 및 제품 빌드 반영 상태를 추적하세요.

items.headline: Camera2CaptureSequenceProcessor의 부분 Surface 캡처 요청 거부 및 재시도 메커니즘 도입
items.lead: CameraPipe 파이프라인에서 일부 Surface가 준비되지 않은 상태로 제출된 캡처 요청을 유실하지 않고 명령 큐에 보존하여 재시도하는 로직이 추가되었습니다.
items.takeaway: 비동기 Surface 바인딩 시차 환경에서 partial Surface 요청 거부 및 GraphLoop invalidate 신호에 따른 재시도 동작을 점검하세요.

items.headline: Android 16 특정 기기의 세션 재구성 지연을 우회하는 CameraDevice 강제 종료 쿼크
items.lead: 유스케이스를 다시 바인딩하거나 전면과 후면 카메라를 전환할 때 프레임 수신이 멈추는 현상을 막기 위해, Android 16 환경의 특정 기기에서 세션 전환 시 CameraDevice 자체를 완전히 닫았다가 다시 열도록 쿼크 규칙이 확장되었습니다.
items.takeaway: HAL이나 프레임워크 내부의 camera3_device_t 핸들 및 flush 로직을 직접 수정하지 않고, 상위 CameraX 레벨에서 장치를 완전히 닫고 다시 열도록 강제하여 스트림 플러시 실패를 우회하는 패치입니다.

items.headline: 10비트 역량 선언이 누락된 기기에서 다이내믹 레인지 프로필을 SDR로 제한
items.lead: 카메라 메타데이터에 10비트 다이내믹 레인지 프로필이 나열되어 있더라도 기기가 10비트 역량을 선언하지 않았다면 CameraX가 프로필을 해석하지 않고 SDR 지원만 보고하도록 변경되었습니다.
items.takeaway: HAL 구현 시 10비트 HDR 프로필 키만 노출하고 DYNAMIC_RANGE_TEN_BIT 역량을 누락하면 상위 프레임워크와의 계약 위반이 발생하므로 메타데이터 정합성 검증이 필수적입니다.

items.headline: CameraPipe CaptureSessionState 개편으로 지연 서피스 요청 누락 방지
items.lead: CameraX의 차세대 백엔드인 CameraPipe에서 세션 생성 직후 지연 서피스가 등록될 때 초기 캡처 요청이 재전송되지 못하고 정체되던 동기화 결함이 해소되었습니다.
items.takeaway: HAL 드라이버 인터페이스 계약 변경은 아니지만, 지연 서피스 패턴에서 세션 구성 직후 보류된 캡처 요청이 빠짐없이 유입되므로 초기 스트림 요청 인입 신뢰성을 검증하는 데 유용합니다.

items.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5: 반복 코딩 작업을 위한 저비용 보조 모델
items.lead: 빌드 오류 요약이나 단순 분류처럼 반복되는 작업을 큰 모델에 모두 맡길 필요가 줄어듭니다. Anthropic은 이런 작업과 코딩 보조 에이전트를 겨냥한 Haiku 5.5를 발표했습니다.

items.lead: Qualcomm CAMSS 하위 시스템의 ISP 파라미터를 제어하기 위한 V4L2 메타데이터 포맷 문서화 패치 시리즈가 v10 리비전으로 검토되고 있습니다.

reader_brief.intro: This week, we cover 8 news items, including 'AOSP cameraserver proposes a patch to maintain conditional mute during privacy toggle' and 'Fixing NullPointerException and session timeouts that occurred during early completion callbacks for Camera Extensions'.

items.headline: AOSP cameraserver proposes patch to maintain conditional mute during privacy toggle
items.lead: An Android patch has been proposed to maintain the connection and only block video for on-screen apps when camera access is turned off. This applies only to devices that support this behavior and is not yet a confirmed change.
items.takeaway: This is a matter to check whether only video is blocked while the connection is maintained for apps displayed on screen on supported devices. It is also necessary to check whether devices that do not support the feature and other apps are disconnected as before.

items.headline: Fixes NullPointerException and session timeouts that occurred during early completion callbacks for Camera Extensions
items.lead: An exception that caused abnormal termination of the handler thread when a capture completion callback arrived early while using the CameraX Extension API has been resolved by improving the synchronization structure.
items.takeaway: When integrating Camera Extensions, check for exceptions in the CXCP-Camera-H thread under early completion callback conditions and track the reflection status in library and product builds.

items.headline: Introduction of Camera2CaptureSequenceProcessor's partial Surface capture request rejection and retry mechanism
items.lead: Logic has been added to the CameraPipe pipeline to preserve capture requests submitted with some Surfaces not ready in the command queue and retry them, preventing loss.
items.takeaway: Check the partial Surface request rejection and retry behavior based on the GraphLoop invalidate signal in an asynchronous Surface binding time lag environment.

items.headline: CameraDevice forced termination quirk to bypass session reconfiguration delays on specific Android 16 devices
items.lead: To prevent frames from stopping when rebinding use cases or switching between front and rear cameras, a quirk rule has been extended for specific Android 16 devices to completely close and reopen the CameraDevice itself during session transitions.
items.takeaway: This patch bypasses stream flush failures by forcing the device to be completely closed and reopened at the higher CameraX level, instead of directly modifying the camera3_device_t handle or flush logic within the HAL or framework.

items.headline: Restricting dynamic range profiles to SDR on devices missing 10-bit capability declaration
items.lead: Even if 10-bit dynamic range profiles are listed in camera metadata, if the device does not declare 10-bit capability, CameraX will not interpret the profiles and will only report SDR support.
items.takeaway: When implementing HAL, exposing only 10-bit HDR profile keys and omitting the DYNAMIC_RANGE_TEN_BIT capability results in a breach of contract with the higher framework, making metadata consistency verification essential.

items.headline: CameraPipe CaptureSessionState refactoring prevents loss of delayed surface requests
items.lead: A synchronization defect in CameraPipe, CameraX's next-generation backend, has been resolved, where initial capture requests were not retransmitted and stalled when delayed surfaces were registered immediately after session creation.
items.takeaway: Although it is not a change to the HAL driver interface contract, it is useful for verifying the reliability of initial stream request ingress because pending capture requests are fully received immediately after session configuration in delayed surface patterns.

items.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5: Low-cost auxiliary model for repetitive coding tasks
items.lead: The need to rely on large models for repetitive tasks like build error summarization or simple classification is reduced. Anthropic has announced Haiku 5.5, targeting these tasks and coding auxiliary agents.
items.takeaway: Development tool managers can compare the current model and Haiku 5.5 using build error log summarization and classification samples. The criterion for adoption is to measure whether cost and response time improvements can be achieved while maintaining accuracy and omission rates.

items.headline: Discussion on Qualcomm CAMSS ISP parameter uAPI format documentation v10 patch
items.lead: A patch series documenting the V4L2 metadata format for controlling Qualcomm CAMSS subsystem's ISP parameters is being reviewed at v10 revision.
items.takeaway: When integrating Qualcomm platform kernel drivers, it is necessary to pre-check changes to the qcom-camss-config.h uAPI structure and v4l2_isp common header.

reader_brief.intro: This week's newsletter brings important information about preparing for Android 17 Camera ITS. Learn more about what to check beyond the Python package list, including the execution environment version and changed verification items. Also, there's news about a libcamera AWB proposal. See how a new approach of fixing automatic gain and reconverging when needed can improve color changes.

items.headline: Android 17 Camera ITS: Runtime Versions and Updated Tests
items.lead: When preparing for Android 17 Camera ITS, it's not just the Python package list that needs to be aligned. The versions of Python and FFmpeg executables, test charts, and CTS Verifier activity configurations must be checked together.
items.takeaway: When analyzing verification failures, it is necessary to distinguish between differences in the execution environment version/path, chart configuration, and HAL output. In particular, YUV/JPEG color differences and white balance between JPEG_R preview/capture are items to compare results against new inspection conditions.

image.alt: Android Open Source Project

items.headline: libcamera AWB Proposal: Freeze Automatic Gains and Trigger Reconvergence
items.lead: This proposal aims to improve the behavior where colors suddenly change when turning off automatic white balance by reverting to the old manual gain. It adds a flow that maintains the last automatic gain and updates to a new gain only when requested.
items.takeaway: The core is the gain to maintain when turning off AWB and the re-search operation in manual mode. In libcamera-based implementations, this behavior and the expression of the AWB state in the upper layer should be reviewed together, but the current patch's convergence criteria should not be applied as a finalized contract.

reader_brief.intro: 이번 주 뉴스레터에서는 Android 17 Camera ITS 준비에 대한 중요한 정보를 전해드립니다. 실행 환경 버전과 달라진 검증 항목을 통해 Python 패키지 목록 외에 확인해야 할 사항들을 자세히 알아보세요. 또한, libcamera AWB 제안에 대한 소식도 있습니다. 자동 게인을 고정하고 필요할 때 다시 수렴시키는 새로운 접근 방식이 어떻게 색 변화를 개선할 수 있는지 살펴보시기 바랍니다.

items.takeaway: Although there are no direct Android HAL changes, the ISP and IVC control interfaces exposed via the V4L2 uAPI in the lower driver layer, as well as frame start and stop interrupt timings, need to be reviewed.

items.headline: Proposed Linux Kernel Driver Patch v3 for Samsung S5K3T2 Image Sensor Support
items.lead: A Linux kernel driver patch has been proposed to support Samsung's 20-megapixel CMOS image sensor, the S5K3T2, which is expected to contribute to future new device integration.
items.takeaway: Although there are no direct HAL changes, when introducing the S5K3T2 sensor, the sensor mode settings via the V4L2 subdevice and MIPI D-PHY lane configuration should be reviewed in advance.

items.headline: Sharing Latest Kernel and libcamera Test Results for Sony IMX681 Camera Sensor Support Patch v7
items.lead: A report on testing Sony IMX681 camera sensor support patch series v7 in the latest kernel and libcamera environment has been released. The tester built the kernel after additional modifications but reported finding several issues during camera inspection.
items.takeaway: Although there are no direct HAL changes, if considering the adoption of IMX681, it is advisable to confirm how the reported CPU/GPU path issues and build modifications are resolved in subsequent versions before scheduling integration, rather than using v7 as is.

reader_brief.intro: This week covers 5 stories, including ‘Claude Code projects feature redesigned, with conversational profiling and parallel PR opening’ and ‘Claude Code v2.1.271 released, with fast mode for remote sessions and improved TUI mouse support’.

items.headline: Claude Code projects feature redesigned, with conversational profiling and parallel PR opening
items.lead: The project management feature of the AI coding tool Claude Code has been fully redesigned. Developers can now automate tasks such as code profiling, optimization testing, and parallel PR creation through conversational sessions.
items.takeaway: Teams that review changes across multiple repositories can try out parallel PRs and the test flow with a single small task that can run in the cloud. Because each thread works on a separate branch and repository copy, merge conflicts need to be reviewed when the same code is modified. This does not mean that HAL builds or sensor validation that depend on local equipment or the internal network will run as-is in the cloud.

image.alt: Claude projects redesigned interface showing conversation-based workflow

items.headline: Claude Code v2.1.271 released, with fast mode for remote sessions and improved TUI mouse support
items.lead: Claude Code, an AI terminal coding tool, has been updated to v2.1.271. The main points of this update are a fast mode that speeds up processing in remote development sessions and improved mouse usability in the terminal user interface (TUI).
items.takeaway: There is no direct change to HAL behavior, but it is useful for engineers who analyze and debug C++ camera stack code on large build servers or remote self-hosted runners. Using fast mode in remote sessions can reduce waiting time when analyzing complex build error logs or summarizing static analysis results, which helps maintain the continuity of the debugging workflow.

image.alt: Claude Code v2.1.271 release open graph image

items.headline: Codex rust-v0.155.1 released, improving API compatibility by disabling reasoning summaries by default in local TUI sessions
items.lead: The rust-v0.155.1 release of the Codex CLI disables reasoning summaries by default in new local TUI sessions. It fixes request rejections by API providers that do not support reasoning summaries, while preserving explicitly specified settings.
items.takeaway: If you have run into request rejections while performing code analysis with the Codex CLI connected to a different API provider, you can check the reasoning summaries setting of new local TUI sessions. After updating, check whether the issue reproduces by distinguishing between the default setting and an explicitly enabled setting. This fix concerns whether reasoning summaries are supported; it does not guarantee full API compatibility or offline operation.

image.alt: Codex rust-v0.155.1 release open graph image

items.headline: Intel IPU6 driver: v2 patch series proposed to prepare for multi-stream and metadata support
items.lead: A v2 series of 21 patches preparing multi-stream and metadata support for the Intel IPU6 driver has been proposed. Together with follow-up patches, it is preparatory work for handling multiple streams from a single source; it is not an announcement that the feature is complete with this series alone.
items.takeaway: Teams reviewing IPU6 changes will find it useful to first check the dependency relationship between this series and the follow-up metadata patches, and to run regression checks that existing single-stream capture still works before and after a backport. Verification of multi-stream behavior should be done on a configuration that includes the required follow-up patches. The proposal does not guarantee Android HAL3 API changes, complete simultaneous YUV/RAW support, or any buffer latency or performance improvement figures.

items.headline: DMI quirk patch proposed to fix upside-down rear camera output on Microsoft Surface Pro 11
items.lead: A patch has been proposed that adds a DMI-based 180-degree rotation per-device quirk to the camera driver, to fix the rear camera image being output upside down on the Microsoft Surface Pro 11 (Intel) model.
items.takeaway: It can serve as an example when investigating sensor orientation errors, comparing the firmware's SSDB and _PLD information against the actual mounting orientation. On the affected Surface Pro 11 (Intel) model, compare the camera_sensor_rotation and libcamera Rotation values before and after the patch, and also check the preview and capture orientation. This patch alone does not guarantee Android SENSOR_ORIENTATION mapping, removal of GPU/CPU rotation cost, or passing CTS/VTS.

items.takeaway: 직접적인 HAL 동작 변화는 없으나, 대규모 빌드 서버나 원격 자체 호스팅 러너 환경에서 C++ 카메라 스택 코드를 분석하고 디버깅하는 엔지니어들에게 유용합니다. 원격 세션의 빠른 모드를 활용하면 복잡한 빌드 오류 로그 분석이나 정적 분석 결과 요약 시 대기 시간을 줄일 수 있어, 디버깅 워크플로우의 연속성을 유지하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

items.takeaway: 다른 API 제공업체와 Codex CLI를 연결해 코드 분석을 수행하다 요청 거부를 겪었다면, 새 로컬 TUI 세션의 추론 요약 설정을 확인할 수 있습니다. 업데이트 후 기본 설정과 명시적으로 활성화한 설정을 구분해 재현 여부를 점검하세요. 이번 수정은 추론 요약 지원 여부에 관한 것으로, 모든 API 호환성이나 오프라인 동작을 보장하지는 않습니다.

items.headline: Intel IPU6 드라이버, 멀티 스트림 및 메타데이터 지원을 위한 v2 패치 시리즈 제안
items.lead: Intel IPU6 드라이버의 멀티 스트림·메타데이터 지원을 준비하는 21개 패치의 v2 시리즈가 제안되었습니다. 후속 패치와 함께 단일 소스의 여러 스트림을 처리하기 위한 준비 작업이며, 이 시리즈만으로 기능이 완성되었다는 발표는 아닙니다.
items.takeaway: IPU6 변경을 검토하는 팀은 이 시리즈와 후속 메타데이터 패치의 의존 관계를 먼저 확인하고, 백포트 전후의 기존 단일 스트림 캡처가 유지되는지 회귀 검증하는 것이 유용합니다. 여러 스트림의 동작 확인은 필요한 후속 패치까지 포함한 구성에서 진행해야 합니다. 제안문은 Android HAL3 API 변경, YUV/RAW 동시 지원 완성, 버퍼 지연이나 성능 개선 수치를 보장하지 않습니다.

items.headline: Microsoft Surface Pro 11 후면 카메라 거꾸로 출력되는 현상 해결을 위한 DMI 보정 패치 제안

items.takeaway: 센서 방향 오류를 조사할 때 펌웨어의 SSDB·_PLD 정보와 실제 장착 방향을 대조하는 사례로 활용할 수 있습니다. 해당 Surface Pro 11 (Intel) 모델에서는 패치 전후의 camera_sensor_rotation과 libcamera Rotation 값을 비교하고 프리뷰·캡처 방향을 함께 확인하세요. 이 패치만으로 Android SENSOR_ORIENTATION 매핑, GPU/CPU 회전 비용 제거 또는 CTS/VTS 통과가 보장되지는 않습니다.

reader_brief.intro: This week covers 4 stories, including ‘Rockchip RKISP1 ISP driver: patch posted to fix Bayer demosaicing bypass logic error’ and ‘New Linux driver patch posted for the OmniVision os02g10 image sensor’.

items.headline: Rockchip RKISP1 ISP driver: patch posted to fix Bayer demosaicing bypass logic error
items.lead: A patch has been proposed that fixes a logic error in the Rockchip RKISP1 ISP driver where the Bayer demosaicing bypass bit was handled inversely.
items.takeaway: There is no direct Android Camera HAL change, but because the demosaicing bypass logic of the underlying ISP driver is being fixed, color distortion or noise control behavior may change when outputting RAW streams and applying ISP tuning parameters. Quality verification of RAW and YUV streams should be performed at the HAL layer.

items.headline: New Linux driver patch posted for the OmniVision os02g10 image sensor
items.lead: A new V4L2 driver patch series (v5) has been proposed to officially support the OmniVision os02g10 image sensor.
items.takeaway: With the addition of the new sensor driver, a lower-level path has been secured for implementing manual exposure and gain control (SENSOR_EXPOSURE_TIME, SENSOR_SENSITIVITY), flip control, and more in the Android Camera HAL. The 1080p30 SBGGR10 stream configuration should be mapped into the HAL's stream map, and its integration with the V4L2 controls should be verified.

items.headline: libcamera: patch proposed to fix Sony IMX355 sensor test pattern mode mapping
items.lead: A patch has been proposed in the libcamera project that corrects a test pattern mode mapping error for the Sony IMX355 sensor, improving the verification reliability of the lower camera stack.
items.takeaway: There is no direct HAL change, but because the IMX355 sensor's test pattern mapping is fixed in the lower libcamera layer, it can ensure that the correct hardware test pattern is output when the Camera HAL sets SENSOR_TEST_PATTERN_MODE. This is useful for CTS test pattern verification and for debugging the data path between the sensor and the HAL.

items.headline: libcamera: proposal to add LensShadingCorrection and ToneCurve to controls metadata
items.lead: A patch has been proposed for libcamera that provides lens shading correction maps and tone curves as frame result metadata, aiming to match the color reproduction of DNG files to JPEG.
items.takeaway: The key is to check the frame results of the Raspberry Pi pipeline together with the DNG saving path. You can compare DNG and JPEG of the same scene and verify that the channel layout and size of the lens shading correction maps, and the tone curve data, are correctly reflected in the file. Android Camera HAL integration is an area that requires separate implementation and verification, and this patch does not include changes that connect HAL requests to ISP control.

items.takeaway: 직접적인 Android Camera HAL 변경은 없으나, 하위 ISP 드라이버의 demosaicing 바이패스 로직이 수정됨에 따라 RAW 스트림 출력 및 ISP 튜닝 파라미터 적용 시 색상 왜곡이나 노이즈 제어 동작이 달라질 수 있습니다. HAL 계층에서 RAW 및 YUV 스트림의 품질 검증을 수행해야 합니다.

items.headline: OmniVision os02g10 이미지 센서용 신규 리눅스 드라이버 패치 공개
items.lead: OmniVision os02g10 이미지 센서를 공식 지원하기 위한 신규 V4L2 드라이버 패치 시리즈(v5)가 제안되었습니다.
items.takeaway: 새로운 센서 드라이버의 추가로 Android Camera HAL에서 수동 노출 및 게인 제어(SENSOR_EXPOSURE_TIME, SENSOR_SENSITIVITY), 플립 제어 등을 구현할 수 있는 하위 경로가 확보되었습니다. 1080p30 SBGGR10 스트림 구성을 HAL의 스트림 맵에 매핑하고 V4L2 컨트롤과의 연동을 검증해야 합니다.

items.headline: libcamera, Sony IMX355 센서 테스트 패턴 모드 매핑 수정 패치 제안
items.lead: libcamera 프로젝트에서 Sony IMX355 센서의 테스트 패턴 모드 매핑 오류를 바로잡아 하위 카메라 스택의 검증 신뢰성을 높이는 패치가 제안되었습니다.
items.takeaway: 직접적인 HAL 변경은 없으나, 하위 libcamera 계층에서 IMX355 센서의 테스트 패턴 매핑이 수정됨에 따라 Camera HAL에서 SENSOR_TEST_PATTERN_MODE를 설정할 때 정확한 하드웨어 테스트 패턴이 출력되도록 보장할 수 있습니다. 이는 CTS 테스트 패턴 검증 및 센서-HAL 간 데이터 경로 디버깅에 유용합니다.

items.headline: libcamera, 컨트롤 메타데이터에 LensShadingCorrection 및 ToneCurve 추가 제안
items.lead: libcamera에서 렌즈 음영 보정 맵과 톤 곡선을 프레임 결과 메타데이터로 제공하여, DNG 파일의 색 재현을 JPEG에 맞추려는 패치가 제안되었습니다.
items.takeaway: Raspberry Pi 파이프라인의 프레임 결과와 DNG 저장 경로를 함께 확인하는 것이 핵심입니다. 같은 장면의 DNG와 JPEG를 비교하고, 렌즈 음영 보정 맵의 채널 구성과 크기, 톤 곡선 데이터가 파일에 올바르게 반영되는지 검증할 수 있습니다. Android Camera HAL 연동은 별도 구현과 검증이 필요한 영역이며, 이 패치에 HAL 요청을 ISP 제어로 연결하는 변경은 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

reader_brief.intro: This week covers 5 stories, including ‘Linux kernel patch v6 posted to support the OmniVision OG0VA1B monochrome VGA sensor driver’ and ‘Qualcomm x1e/Hamoa platform camera DTS support patch v6 posted’.

items.headline: Linux kernel patch v6 posted to support the OmniVision OG0VA1B monochrome VGA sensor driver
items.lead: A v6 patch series has been posted to add a driver to the Linux media subsystem for the OG0VA1B, OmniVision's 1/10-inch low-power monochrome VGA sensor. With support for a single-lane MIPI CSI-2 interface and Y10 RAW format output, it appears set to lay the groundwork for building embedded and mobile monochrome camera pipelines.
items.takeaway: There is no direct Android Camera HAL change, but because a 10-bit monochrome RAW (Y10) format is added at the lower V4L2 driver level, when implementing HAL3 you should check that the Y10 format is correctly defined in the RAW stream configuration and the ISP pixel format mapping table.

items.headline: Qualcomm x1e/Hamoa platform camera DTS support patch v6 posted
items.lead: A v6 patch adding Device Tree Source (DTS) support that defines the camera hardware configuration of the Qualcomm x1e/Hamoa platform has been posted. This update focuses on improving hardware initialization stability, for example by aligning the data lane ordering of the CAMSS node with the PHY layer and making the power supply schema consistent.
items.takeaway: There is no direct HAL change, but the data lane alignment and power supply changes directly affect the physical connection stability of the camera subsystem. Lower-stack verification should be done first so that MIPI CSI-2 receiver initialization errors or power-on failures do not occur at the driver level.

items.headline: Linux kernel patch v7 posted for Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91 camera support
items.lead: A v7 patch series has been posted to fully support the front and rear camera system of the Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91. This patch contains comprehensive hardware control logic covering not only the OV8858 and OV2740 image sensor drivers but also AtomISP, the IPU bridge, and the WV517S lens actuator.
items.takeaway: There is no direct HAL change, but because the OV2740's manual white balance and the OV8858's gain control are exposed as V4L2 controls, you should verify that Camera HAL3 3A metadata control requests are accurately mapped to the kernel driver's V4L2 controls and work correctly.

items.headline: libcamera control storage union naming patch v3 accepted
items.lead: A v3 patch giving a clear name to the control storage union structure inside libcamera was submitted and moved to accepted state. The stated purpose in the commit message is to make it possible to copy the storage as a single unit regardless of which member is active, and this patch is the first of a 5-patch series that introduces a move constructor and a swap() operation.
items.takeaway: This part by itself is a step that tidies up the storage representation, so it does not change HAL runtime behavior. However, projects that customize the libcamera source and integrate it into the lower layers of an Android HAL should check build compatibility to make sure the union naming change does not cause compile errors in existing custom control code.

items.headline: libcamera patch posted to skip unnecessary stop call before the software ISP worker starts
items.lead: A patch has been submitted that fixes a problem in libcamera's software image signal processing (software_isp) component where a call would hang indefinitely when starting the camera failed. It changes the code to return early instead of waiting for a worker thread that has not yet started, so that the original capture error is passed on to the caller as-is.
items.takeaway: There is no direct HAL change, but if you have seen a symptom where opening the camera fails and the call hangs without returning in a pipeline that goes through the software ISP, you can suspect this path. Please check, with a scenario that deliberately injects a capture start failure, that the error is propagated up to the upper layers.

items.headline: OmniVision OG0VA1B 흑백 VGA 센서 드라이버 지원을 위한 Linux 커널 패치 v6 공개
items.lead: Linux 미디어 하위 시스템에 OmniVision의 1/10인치 저전력 흑백 VGA 센서인 OG0VA1B 드라이버를 추가하기 위한 v6 패치 시리즈가 공개되었습니다. 단일 레인 MIPI CSI-2 인터페이스와 Y10 RAW 포맷 출력을 지원하여, 임베디드 및 모바일 흑백 카메라 파이프라인 구축의 기반이 마련될 것으로 보입니다.
items.takeaway: 직접적인 Android Camera HAL 변경은 없으나, 하위 V4L2 드라이버 레벨에서 10비트 흑백 RAW (Y10) 포맷이 추가되므로 HAL3 구현 시 RAW 스트림 구성 및 ISP 픽셀 포맷 매핑 테이블에 Y10 형식이 올바르게 정의되어 있는지 점검해야 합니다.

items.headline: Qualcomm x1e/Hamoa 플랫폼 카메라 DTS 지원 패치 v6 공개
items.lead: Qualcomm x1e/Hamoa 플랫폼의 카메라 하드웨어 구성을 정의하는 Device Tree Source (DTS) 지원 v6 패치가 공개되었습니다. 이번 업데이트는 CAMSS 노드의 데이터 레인 정렬을 PHY 계층과 일치시키고 전원 공급 스키마를 정합화하는 등 하드웨어 초기화 안정성을 높이는 데 초점을 맞추었습니다.
items.takeaway: 직접적인 HAL 변경은 없으나, 데이터 레인 정렬 및 전원 공급 변경은 카메라 서브시스템의 물리적 연결 안정성에 직결됩니다. 드라이버 레벨에서 MIPI CSI-2 수신기 초기화 에러나 전원 인가 실패가 발생하지 않도록 하위 스택 검증을 선행해야 합니다.

items.headline: Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91 카메라 지원을 위한 Linux 커널 패치 v7 공개
items.lead: Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91의 전면 및 후면 카메라 시스템을 완벽히 지원하기 위한 v7 패치 시리즈가 공개되었습니다. 이번 패치는 OV8858 및 OV2740 이미지 센서 드라이버뿐만 아니라, AtomISP, IPU 브리지, 그리고 WV517S 렌즈 액추에이터까지 아우르는 종합적인 하드웨어 제어 로직을 담고 있습니다.
items.takeaway: 직접적인 HAL 변경은 없으나, OV2740의 수동 화이트 밸런스 및 OV8858의 게인 제어 기능이 V4L2 컨트롤로 노출되므로, Camera HAL3의 3A 메타데이터 제어 요청이 커널 드라이버의 V4L2 컨트롤러에 정확히 매핑되고 정상 동작하는지 검증해야 합니다.

items.headline: libcamera 컨트롤 스토리지 유니온 명명 패치 v3 승인
items.lead: libcamera 내부의 컨트롤 스토리지 유니온 구조체에 명확한 이름을 부여하는 v3 패치가 제출되어 accepted 상태로 전환되었습니다. 커밋 메시지가 밝힌 목적은 활성 멤버가 무엇이든 저장소를 한 단위로 복사할 수 있게 만드는 것이며, 이 패치는 이동 생성자와 swap() 연산을 도입하는 5패치 시리즈의 첫 번째입니다.
items.takeaway: 이 조각 자체는 저장소 표현을 정리하는 단계라 HAL 런타임 동작을 바꾸지 않습니다. 다만 libcamera 소스를 커스텀하여 Android HAL 하위 계층에 연동하는 프로젝트라면, 유니온 명명 변경으로 기존 커스텀 제어 코드에서 컴파일 에러가 나지 않는지 빌드 호환성을 점검해야 합니다.

items.headline: libcamera 소프트웨어 ISP 워커 시작 전 불필요한 stop 호출 생략 패치 공개
items.lead: libcamera의 소프트웨어 이미지 신호 처리(software_isp) 컴포넌트에서 카메라 시작이 실패했을 때 호출이 무한정 멈추던 문제를 고치는 패치가 제출되었습니다. 아직 구동되지 않은 워커 스레드를 기다리지 않고 일찍 반환하도록 바꾸어, 원래의 캡처 오류가 호출자에게 그대로 전달되게 합니다.
items.takeaway: 직접적인 HAL 변경은 없으나, 소프트웨어 ISP를 경유하는 파이프라인에서 카메라 열기가 실패했는데도 호출이 반환되지 않고 멈추는 증상을 겪었다면 이 경로를 의심해 볼 수 있습니다. 캡처 시작 실패를 일부러 주입하는 시나리오로 오류가 상위 계층까지 전달되는지 확인하시기 바랍니다.

reader_brief.intro: This week covers 5 stories, including ‘AtomISP driver adds Lenovo Yoga Book OV2740 sensor link and D-PHY timing derivation support’ and ‘libcamera reviews patch adding Quad-Bayer CFA layout support for high-resolution sensor handling’.

items.headline: AtomISP driver adds Lenovo Yoga Book OV2740 sensor link and D-PHY timing derivation support
items.lead: A PATCH v3 patch series improving the integration of the AtomISP bridge driver and the OV2740 image sensor has been submitted to the Linux kernel media subsystem. This change compensates at the driver level for incomplete camera link information in the hardware firmware, and supports dynamically deriving D-PHY timing from the sensor link frequency.
items.takeaway: Driver-level D-PHY timing derivation and padding handling pass through the V4L2 subsystem and affect stream configuration validation in the Android Camera HAL. In particular, during RAW Bayer capture, if the padding pixels (12 pixels) are not correctly reflected in metadata (such as the active array size), image distortion or CTS test failures can occur, so this should be checked carefully.

items.headline: libcamera reviews patch adding Quad-Bayer CFA layout support for high-resolution sensor handling
items.lead: A patch has been proposed that adds support to the libcamera framework for the Quad-Bayer CFA (Color Filter Array) layout, which is widely used in recent high-resolution image sensors. This change is expected to contribute to improving the accuracy of RAW data processing in the lower image processing pipeline.
items.takeaway: With the libcamera layer directly recognizing and handling the Quad-Bayer CFA layout, the debayering quality and the accuracy of stride calculation for the RAW data that the Android Camera HAL receives from the lower stack are improved. This helps prevent buffer overflows or memory alignment errors when the HAL processes RAW_SENSOR or RAW10/RAW12 streams.

items.headline: Linux kernel: Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91 camera driver and sensor integration patch series posted
items.lead: A Linux kernel driver patch series (PATCH v2) to fully support the camera hardware of the Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91 device has been posted. This patch focuses on compensating at the driver level for missing ACPI firmware information and integrating control of the front/rear sensors and the lens actuator.
items.takeaway: With RAW Bayer capture exposure, per-channel white balance control, and a lens actuator (WV517S) added at the driver level, the Camera HAL can directly map the 3A (Auto Exposure, Auto White Balance, Auto Focus) controls of this hardware through V4L2 controls. This is essential for meeting the HAL's `android.control` metadata contract and passing CTS/VTS verification.

items.headline: Sony IMX908 image sensor: Linux Device Tree binding added, laying the groundwork for official support
items.lead: A Device Tree binding patch (PATCH v3) for official Linux kernel support of the Sony IMX908 image sensor has been posted. This binding definition provides a standard hardware interface configuration guide for developers of SoC platforms that carry the new sensor.
items.takeaway: When the sensor's MIPI CSI-2 lane count (2 or 4 lanes) and RAW formats (RAW10/RAW12) are correctly defined in the kernel through the Device Tree binding, the Camera HAL can query accurate sensor resolution (3856x2176) and format information from the driver. This contributes to building the HAL's `SensorCharacteristics` metadata and securing the stability of high-resolution RAW stream combinations.

items.headline: libcamera adds filter parameter to createTexture2D() in the software ISP EGL module
items.lead: A v15 patch has been posted that allows fine-tuning of image processing quality in the software ISP EGL module of the libcamera framework. This change adds a parameter so that filtering options can be controlled directly when creating textures, increasing the flexibility of the GPU-accelerated rendering pipeline.
items.takeaway: Because filtering options can now be controlled when the software ISP creates EGL textures, visual quality (e.g., reduced aliasing, sharpness adjustment) can be fine-tuned in GPU-accelerated image scaling or debayering post-processing stages. This directly affects improving preview image quality when implementing a libcamera-based Android Camera HAL on entry-level SoC platforms without a hardware ISP.

items.takeaway: 드라이버 레벨의 D-PHY 타이밍 파생 및 패딩 처리는 V4L2 서브시스템을 거쳐 Android Camera HAL의 스트림 구성 유효성 검사에 영향을 미칩니다. 특히 RAW Bayer 캡처 시 패딩 픽셀(12픽셀)이 메타데이터(active array size 등)에 정확히 반영되지 않으면 이미지 왜곡이나 CTS 테스트 실패가 발생할 수 있으므로 주의 깊게 점검해야 합니다.

items.headline: libcamera, 고해상도 센서 처리를 위한 쿼드-베이어(Quad-Bayer) CFA 레이아웃 지원 패치 검토
items.lead: libcamera 프레임워크에 최신 고해상도 이미지 센서에서 널리 사용되는 쿼드-베이어(Quad-Bayer) CFA(Color Filter Array) 레이아웃 지원을 추가하는 패치가 제안되었습니다. 이번 변경은 하위 이미지 처리 파이프라인에서 RAW 데이터 처리의 정확성을 높이는 데 기여할 것으로 기대됩니다.
items.takeaway: libcamera 계층에서 쿼드-베이어 CFA 레이아웃을 직접 인식하고 처리함으로써, Android Camera HAL이 하위 스택에서 수신하는 RAW 데이터의 디베이어링(debayering) 품질과 스트라이드 계산의 정확도가 향상됩니다. 이는 HAL이 RAW_SENSOR 또는 RAW10/RAW12 스트림을 처리할 때 버퍼 오버플로우나 메모리 정렬 오류를 방지하는 데 기여합니다.

items.headline: Linux 커널, Lenovo Yoga Book YB1-X91 카메라 드라이버 및 센서 통합 패치 시리즈 공개

items.takeaway: 드라이버 레벨에서 RAW Bayer 캡처 노출, 채널별 화이트 밸런스 제어, 렌즈 액추에이터(WV517S)가 추가됨에 따라, Camera HAL은 해당 하드웨어의 3A(Auto Exposure, Auto White Balance, Auto Focus) 제어 기능을 V4L2 컨트롤을 통해 직접 매핑할 수 있게 됩니다. 이는 HAL의 `android.control` 메타데이터 계약을 충족하고 CTS/VTS 검증을 통과하는 데 필수적입니다.

items.headline: Sony IMX908 이미지 센서, Linux Device Tree 바인딩 추가로 공식 지원 기반 마련
items.lead: Sony IMX908 이미지 센서의 Linux 커널 공식 지원을 위한 Device Tree 바인딩 패치(PATCH v3)가 공개되었습니다. 이번 바인딩 정의는 신규 센서를 탑재하는 SoC 플랫폼 개발자들에게 표준 하드웨어 인터페이스 구성 가이드를 제공합니다.
items.takeaway: Device Tree 바인딩을 통해 센서의 MIPI CSI-2 레인 수(2 또는 4레인)와 RAW 포맷(RAW10/RAW12)이 커널에 올바르게 정의되면, Camera HAL은 드라이버로부터 정확한 센서 해상도(3856x2176)와 포맷 정보를 쿼리할 수 있습니다. 이는 HAL의 `SensorCharacteristics` 메타데이터를 구성하고, 고해상도 RAW 스트림 조합의 안정성을 확보하는 데 기여합니다.

items.headline: CameraX 1.7.0-alpha03 released: Camera2Interop API overhaul and multi-camera ZSL HAL crash fix
items.lead: The recently published Android Jetpack CameraX 1.7.0-alpha03 release extensively overhauls the Camera2Interop API, the key path through which app developers interact with the underlying Camera2 and HAL layers. Along with this, a critical HAL crash bug that occurred when zooming across physical camera boundaries with ZSL (Zero-Shutter Lag) enabled on multi-camera devices was fixed, significantly improving system stability.
items.takeaway: This change is not a direct HAL3 specification change, but it is closely tied to how the upper framework passes requests to the HAL. In particular, the fix for the HAL crash when switching zoom between physical cameras with ZSL enabled (b/527782712) suggests that multi-camera stream configuration and buffer lifecycle control logic should be reviewed. Also, as in the fix for HDR video recording failures on specific vendor devices such as the Samsung Galaxy S25/S26/Fold 7 (b/529618629), you should verify through VTS and your own scenario tests that no exceptions occur in vendor-specific HDR metadata handling and codec integration.

items.takeaway: The correctness of the device tree bindings determines whether sensor probing and initialization succeed. items.headline: Qualcomm CAMSS: patch proposed to add an OPE (Offline Processing Engine) driver that converts raw Bayer to YUV
items.lead: Patch v5 was proposed to add an OPE (Offline Processing Engine) image processing driver, which converts raw Bayer frames to YUV, to the Qualcomm CAMSS driver.
items.takeaway: This change is a proposal to add an ISP block in the kernel driver layer and does not bring direct changes to the Android Camera HAL API or metadata contract. However, when using offline YUV conversion and ISP hardware acceleration on Qualcomm SoC-based devices, it can become a lower-level foundation for optimizing buffer lifecycle and processing latency in memory-to-memory (M2M) pipelines.

items.headline: New V4L2 driver patch published to support the Himax HM1092 monochrome infrared (IR) sensor
items.lead: A new V4L2 driver patch series adding support for the Himax HM1092 monochrome infrared image sensor was published.
items.takeaway: This patch is a change in the lower driver layer and does not directly affect the Android Camera HAL API or metadata contract. However, devices equipped with this sensor need to configure RAW10 format support and the related stream combination validation at the Camera HAL level to handle the monochrome infrared stream correctly.

items.headline: libcamera: patch proposed to harden control serializer size and input validation
items.lead: The libcamera project has a proposed patch v2 that improves stability by hardening size checks and input validation in the control serializer.
items.takeaway: This patch is a stability improvement inside libcamera and does not bring direct changes to the Android Camera HAL API or metadata contract. However, for systems that build their lower driver stack on libcamera, it can help reduce the risk of crashes in the layers below the HAL by strengthening the exception-handling routines in control data deserialization.

items.headline: libcamera: EGLDisplay caching optimization patch proposed to avoid redundant initialization
items.lead: The libcamera project has a proposed performance optimization patch that caches the EGLDisplay object to avoid redundant graphics resource initialization and teardown overhead.
items.takeaway: This patch is a graphics resource optimization inside libcamera and does not bring direct changes to the Android Camera HAL API or metadata contract. However, when running buffer processing and rendering pipelines in a libcamera-based lower stack, removing redundant EGL initialization overhead can indirectly help reduce camera stream startup latency and the risk of frame drops.

items.headline: Standalone V4L2 driver patch proposed to support the Samsung S5KJN5 50MP image sensor
items.lead: Patch v2 was proposed to support the Samsung S5KJN5 50MP high-resolution image sensor by adding a separate standalone V4L2 driver instead of extending an existing driver.
items.takeaway: This patch is a change in the lower driver layer and does not directly affect the Android Camera HAL API or metadata contract. However, devices equipped with this high-resolution sensor need to define 50MP high-resolution RAW stream and pixel remosaicing processing paths at the Camera HAL level, and should closely verify the resulting impact on memory bandwidth and power consumption.

items.takeaway: GCC 16's improved error messages and SARIF output do not directly change the Android HAL toolchain (Clang/LLVM), but they offer insight into build, debug, and static analysis workflows for C++-based HAL and driver code. items.headline: Himax HM1246 image sensor driver v10 patches proposed for the Linux kernel
items.lead: A v10 patch series to support the Himax HM1246 image sensor was recently proposed to the Linux kernel media subsystem. The driver initially supports only Native RAW mode and is under review with the sensor's internal ISP pipeline not enabled.
items.takeaway: Because the Himax HM1246 driver supports only Native RAW mode, generating YUV or JPEG streams at the Android Camera HAL level requires integration with the AP's hardware ISP or a software image processing pipeline. Architecture design must reflect the fact that simple YUV output using the sensor's internal ISP is not possible.

items.headline: V4L2 sub-device driver patch v10 for the Himax HM1246 image sensor published
items.lead: A v10 patch series for adding a Himax HM1246 image sensor driver was recently submitted to the Linux media mailing list. The sensor supports an I2C interface and a parallel bus and has a built-in internal ISP, and is expected to contribute to future integration into the lower image pipeline of embedded and Android devices.
items.takeaway: Because this patch is still at the proposal stage, it has no direct impact on Android Camera HAL APIs or metadata contracts. However, since it is a parallel-bus sensor with a built-in internal ISP, future HAL integration may require compatibility validation in frame timing and V4L2 sub-device format negotiation.

items.headline: V4L2 driver patch v2 for the Sony IMX576 image sensor published
items.lead: A v2 patch series for supporting the Sony IMX576 image sensor was recently submitted to the Linux media mailing list. The driver includes support for a high-resolution active array along with manual exposure, gain, and blanking controls, and will serve as a foundation for future integration into high-performance camera pipelines.
items.takeaway: The Sony IMX576 sensor's high resolution (5760 x 4312) and manual controls (exposure, gain, blanking) map directly to the manual control features (Manual Camera capabilities) of Android Camera HAL3. Once the driver stabilizes, it will help secure the reliability of the 3A engine and manual metadata control at the HAL level.

items.lead: CameraX 1.6.0 Release Notes (March 25, 2026)
items.takeaway: This release carries significant implications for Camera HAL development teams. With an API now introduced at the upper framework layer to query use-case combination support in advance, the accuracy of the CameraCharacteristics and isStreamCombinationSupported interfaces declared at the HAL level is held to a stricter standard. Also, since instability at the HAL/driver layer, such as the Z Fold 4 YUV distortion and the A53 torch-linked capture failure, is being forcibly worked around (Exclude/Filter) in upper libraries, vendors should re-verify the stream combination reliability and buffer handling logic of their own devices.
